reasons: Skill was loaded and the relevant references (action-writing, action-configs, project-manifest, next-step, workflow-yaml, country-context, angola) were read before designing.

The design keeps the AI/human boundary the request asked for: AI action is standard with ai_agent assignee and reviewRequired, writes only to resumo/alertas fields, is barred from fornecedor_escolhido/motivo_da_escolha, and the supplier choice is a separate human decision action.

Deliverables cover the expected behaviour: workflow.yaml with aiWorker settings, provia-project.json with aiProfiles and decisions, and ai-profile-resumo-propostas.md containing profile instructions plus (per the response) required skills, output contract, review behaviour and 8 evaluation cases; the visible portion of that file is consistent with this structure.

Validation claims are backed by written artifacts: validation.json (valid: true, backendSchemaValidation: passed, 2 assignment_missing) and action-review.json (3/3 complete, dueMissing: 1) match the response; project.html and setup.md exist for the map/--check step.

No invented organization IDs, thresholds, endpoints or legal provisions: tenantId null, mode disconnected, assignee UUIDs left unset, value-limit question kept open as a decision; the denied org_get_context call is disclosed honestly.

Facts, assumptions (D1–D5) and unrun checks (evaluation cases, destination validation, human quality review) are explicitly separated; the response ends with a concrete next-step recommendation and copyable invocation in pt-AO.
